# Assets · Artboards

59 files under `assets/Artboards/`, held in the system’s upload store: read one as the file `_blobs/<id>.<ext>` in this system’s directory, the id below as `<id>` (they are not files under that folder — a read by that path fails), then add it to your own work as an asset (`artifact.mjs upload`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for page-01.jpg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

59 张原始 PDF 页图，按页码排列。第 1–2 页为版本与发布说明，第 3–9 页为基础规范，第 10–27 页为页面与侧栏网格画板，第 28 页为 Script Mark，第 29–59 页为组件及变体。组件页采用 1200px 宽度的本地渲染图；它们是原始参考图，不是可交互实现。完整矢量和更高倍率阅读使用 Sources 中的原始 PDF。
